title: hotcrm: lead.view.ts authors form views with the retired types split / drawer / modal — re-spell to layouts when hotcrm takes the spec release that carries #27229
body:
Filing gate: ② follow-up work owed by landed work. PR #27229 (#27155, ruling 6464210455 letter A′) narrows `FormView.type` to `simple | tabbed | wizard` and retires `split` / `drawer` / `modal` with tombstones. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ This seat cannot reach hotcrm: the reader who acts is the `repo:hotcrm` seat. Transfer this card or mirror it there.

**What is owed.** hotcrm `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts` authors three form views with retired types: ~L747 `split`, ~L796 `drawer` and ~L839 `modal` (measured at hotcrm `6c52f22`, spec pin 18.2.0). When hotcrm bumps to an `@objectstack/spec` release that carries #27229, `objectstack build` refuses these, and stored copies are converted by the ADR-0087 disposition `form-view-presentation-types-removed`.

**Expected.** Re-spell each view to a layout (`tabbed` or `simple`). A side-by-side pane is the reader's own preference. Master-detail goes through `subforms`. The drawer or modal open mode comes from the caller: the list's `navigation.mode` (live values only, since #26804 retired `split`), or an action that opens a page. The tombstone messages in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` carry the same prescription.

**When.** Only with the spec bump that carries #27229, not before. Until then the 18.2.0 pin accepts the old types.

**Dedupe.** `search_issues` on this repo: "hotcrm lead.view.ts FormView type split drawer modal" returned #27155 (the source) and #21500 (closed, unrelated: `formViews` precedence). **New.**
